title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Selfless duty calls you to sacrifice your own spiritual needs and do whatever it takes to protect the world."
"The winds can be brutal, so be brave."
"I'm okay. Just finish the mission!"
"When this is finished, the Avatar will have defeated the Fire Lord, we will have control of the Fire Nation capital, and this war will be over!" —Hakoda
"We're just in the process of improving upon what's already here."
Every creature in the world felt the Avatar's return and paid respects in whatever way it could.
"You'll save the world again. But you can't give up."
The solar eclipse robbed Firebenders of their ability to firebend, giving Team Avatar an eight-minute window to storm the capital and defeat the Fire Lord.
"You miscalculated. I love Zuko more than I fear you."
"Fire is the element of power." —Iroh
Zuko's journey began when he refused to duel his father, but it would end dueling his sister.
"You must be decisive."
"A Waterbender lets their defense become their offense, turning their opponent's energy against them. I learned a way to do this with lightning." —Iroh
Fire Lord Ozai's cruel reign only forged a stronger resolve in the hearts of the resistance.
Every mountain starts as a molehill.
"I wish I could get her a big, open prairie like she likes. I'd let her hop her way to happiness."
"Bosco seems to like him."
"Together, we are unshakable."
"Understanding others, the other elements, and the other nations will help you become whole." —Iroh
"Who's ready to cross this here canyon?"
"Only justice will bring peace."
With the death of the moon spirit, the Avatar's tides of vengeance crashed over the Fire Nation fleet.
When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.
"Let's take them now."
"You know well the cost of war."
"I'm sorry it has to end this way, brother."
"Today, this war is finally over!"
"I will never, ever turn my back on people who need me!"
"Out of the ashes, a new world will be born."
"I'm just a guy with a boomerang!"

paragraphs.text: "Most people think the lotus tile insignificant, but it is essential for the unusual strategy that I employ." —Iroh
Aang once knew this place to be full of monks, lemurs, and bison.
"The frozen tundra is treacherous, the landscape itself is an icy fortress." —Admiral Zhao
Where the secret ingredient truly is love.
